objective: USF Phase One permanent local semantic-validation toolchain realisation

evidence: The active contract and accepted decision authorise an Implementation in maldous/usf at census/local-semantic-validation.
The live realisation state was urn:usf:realisationstate:implementable before source materialisation.
issues.rootCause: The semantic contract and implementation authorisation preceded permanent source materialisation.
issues.proposedResolution: Materialise and validate the permanent host-side package at the exact authorised path.
issues.authorizationRequired: Satisfied by the accepted live realisation decision.
issues.resolutionPerformed: The permanent package was implemented at the authorised path in a dedicated branch and worktree.
validationPerformed: Repository identity and source-path checks pass in preflight.
The implementation contains no runtime source outside the authorised path.
issues.residualUncertainty: Final evidence admission and realisation-state advancement remain tracked separately.

evidence: The host system default Java is 21.0.11 while OpenJDK 25.0.3 is installed at /usr/lib/jvm/java-25-openjdk-amd64.
The active contract requires host OpenJDK feature 25.
issues.rootCause: The host alternatives default predates the toolchain contract.
issues.proposedResolution: Select and require host Java feature 25 without changing the system default.
issues.resolutionPerformed: Both launchers select the host Java 25 installation and preflight rejects every other feature version.
validationPerformed: Automated exact-version acceptance and rejection tests pass.
Maven Enforcer requires Java 25 and Maven 3.9.11.
issues.residualUncertainty: None within the supported host layout.

evidence: The chroot previously contained a manually installed Temurin 21 JRE, tarball, alternatives entry and profile shim.
No removed executable or archive was owned by a chroot package.
The contract disclaims a chroot Java runtime and permits only bounded digest-verified result consumption.
issues.rootCause: Residual manually provisioned Java artifacts and a tracked profile shim remained from an older bootstrap method.
issues.proposedResolution: Remove only verified manual Java artifacts, delete the obsolete tracked shim, and enforce a type-aware boundary scan.
issues.authorizationRequired: Required by the active host/chroot contract and no-runtime nonclaim.
issues.resolutionPerformed: The manual runtime, archive and alternatives entry were removed; the obsolete shim is deleted; preflight scans for runtimes, caches, stores, corpora and raw result artifacts.
validationPerformed: No java or javac executable remains in the chroot.
No Maven or Gradle cache, NativeStore data, complete graph/census corpus, or raw validation output was found.
Host preflight with --chroot-root /home/user/src/usf/v2 passes.
issues.residualUncertainty: Support-only java-common and ca-certificates-java packages remain but provide no runtime executable.

evidence: No permanent project-scoped build launcher existed before this package.
The contract requires a pinned Maven launcher, dependency lock, checksum evidence and normal offline validation.
issues.rootCause: The semantic contract was established before a durable build definition existed.
issues.proposedResolution: Pin Maven, plugins and dependencies; regenerate and compare the runtime lock on every build; prove two clean offline builds are identical.
issues.resolutionPerformed: Maven 3.9.11, its distribution checksum, exact plugin versions, convergence enforcement, reproducible timestamps and a SHA-256 runtime inventory are implemented.
validationPerformed: Offline unit and integration tests pass with 55 tests.
The dependency-lock mismatch planted test passes.
issues.residualUncertainty: Final post-commit two-build byte comparison is pending.

evidence: The live contract selects RDF4J 6.0.0 and Jena 6.1.0.
Jackson 2.20.1, Thrift 0.22.0 and AssertJ 3.27.6 were flagged by the initial generated-SBOM scan.
Thrift 0.24.0 fails Jena TDB2 writes because TReadAppendFileTransport does not implement the new getConfiguration contract.
issues.rootCause: Selected engines bring transitive libraries whose newest releases are not uniformly binary-compatible with Jena 6.1.0.
issues.proposedResolution: Keep the semantically selected engines, use current patched compatible dependencies, and test both engines through real store writes.
issues.authorizationRequired: No engine decision change; compatible transitive remediation is an implementation correction.
issues.resolutionPerformed: Jackson is pinned to final 2.22.1, AssertJ to 3.27.7, and Thrift to patched compatible 0.23.0; the incompatible 0.24.0 candidate was rejected.
validationPerformed: Maven dependency convergence passes.
RDF4J NativeStore and Jena TDB2 named-graph integration tests pass on the converged classpath.
The runtime lock records 117 artifacts with SHA-256 and byte size.
issues.residualUncertainty: Future Jena releases may permit Thrift 0.24.0 and require a separately tested lock refresh.

evidence: OSV Scanner 2.3.8 reports GHSA-5jmj-h7xm-6q6v against Jackson Databind 2.22.1 twice, once per POM and SBOM input.
The official reviewed advisory explicitly lists 2.22.0 as affected and 2.22.1 as the fixed 2.22-line release.
The OSV record uses open-ended introduced ranges despite its explicit affected-version list ending at 2.22.0.
issues.rootCause: The scanner consumes a malformed open-ended ecosystem range and does not honor the advisory's fixed release for the legacy Maven coordinate.
issues.proposedResolution: Retain the raw scan, verify the selected release against the reviewed primary advisory, and do not suppress or rewrite the scanner output.
issues.resolutionPerformed: The latest final Jackson 2.22.1 remains pinned with the reviewed advisory recorded as the false-positive resolution basis.
validationPerformed: The generated CycloneDX 1.6 inventory has 117 components and zero components without license data.
No selected version is in the advisory's explicit affected-version list.
issues.residualUncertainty: OSV Scanner 2.3.8 continues to exit nonzero until its advisory range data or matching behavior is corrected upstream.

evidence: Local main includes the test-harness-boundaries commit and is one commit ahead of origin/main.
The implementation is isolated on agent/local-semantic-validation.
The graph submodule gitlink is unchanged at ad71453f and existing worktrees and stashes were preserved.
issues.rootCause: The prior user-authorised harness commit was backed up to its branch but not yet integrated into origin/main.
issues.proposedResolution: Commit the package, prove it from committed state, integrate by fast-forward, push main and verify all relevant worktrees.
issues.authorizationRequired: The user explicitly authorised commit, push, PR and merge as appropriate.
issues.resolutionPerformed: Dedicated implementation worktree created; no stash, destructive reset, branch deletion or submodule mutation performed.
validationPerformed: Parent/submodule remotes, branches, worktrees, stashes and statuses were audited.
issues.residualUncertainty: Commit, integration and origin synchronization remain pending.

evidence: Earlier bounded Stardog evaluation of unpublished candidate shapes was nonconforming and its diagnostic exceeded 180 seconds.
The Phase One contract requires full RDF4J and Jena SHACL conformance and normalized agreement.
issues.rootCause: Portable current-corpus conformance had not been reproduced by permanent dual-engine source.
issues.proposedResolution: Run full manifest-scoped validation in both selected engines and compare normalized findings without blank-node identity.
issues.authorizationRequired: Implementation is authorised; no shape weakening or semantic correction is authorised by this issue.
issues.resolutionPerformed: Standalone RDF4J and Jena validators plus normalized finding comparison are implemented.
validationPerformed: Normalized cross-engine blank-node and intentional-disagreement tests pass.
issues.residualUncertainty: Final committed full-corpus proof runs remain pending.

evidence: Arbitrary filesystem discovery could load unregistered or derived source into a clean baseline.
The contract requires manifest-only input and exact graph identity.
issues.proposedResolution: Make the governed manifest the sole input inventory and reject unknown, missing, duplicate, wrong-role or default-graph input.
issues.resolutionPerformed: Both loaders consume only exact manifest entries and validate graph roles, input baselines and runtime graph sets.
validationPerformed: Named-graph preservation, unknown TriG graph, clean baseline, missing graph, duplicate mapping and manifest-order tests pass.
issues.residualUncertainty: None for the current manifest schema.

evidence: The local digest must compare outputs deterministically without claiming to be the Stardog authority digest.
Derived blank nodes would make the selected tuple algorithm ambiguous.
issues.rootCause: No replaceable canonical graph-comparison boundary existed.
issues.proposedResolution: Use a named replaceable algorithm that includes exact graph IRIs, sorted length-prefixed terms and rejects derived blank nodes.
issues.authorizationRequired: Within the accepted deterministic comparison contract.
issues.resolutionPerformed: usf-sorted-term-tuples-v1 is implemented behind GraphCanonicalizer and explicitly disclaimed as semantic authority.
validationPerformed: RDF4J/Jena digest parity, graph-identity sensitivity, ordering stability and blank-node rejection tests pass.
issues.residualUncertainty: A future RDFC-1.0 adapter may replace this comparison algorithm without changing engine APIs.

evidence: Per-family summaries alone could conceal nondeterministic or reordered query blocks.
The bounded result must distinguish stable evidence from variable execution measurements.
issues.rootCause: The earlier diagnostic evidence did not provide a permanent block-level chained trace and bounded self-digesting manifest.
issues.proposedResolution: Chain every block's input state, rule digest and canonical output; compare two clean RDF4J runs and Jena; separate stable and variable evidence.
issues.resolutionPerformed: Sixteen manifest-ordered block steps, cross-block duplicate rejection, stableEvidenceDigest and resultDigest are implemented.
validationPerformed: Bounded self-digest and intentional mismatch tests pass.
A pre-commit full-corpus trial produced identical RDF4J and Jena trace identities.
issues.residualUncertainty: Two final clean committed proof executions remain pending.

evidence: Caller-selected work paths could otherwise permit unsafe deletion or leave stores after failure and interruption.
Concurrent proof runs could exceed resource bounds or corrupt shared intent.
issues.rootCause: No permanent ownership marker, process lock or lifecycle cleanup mechanism existed.
issues.proposedResolution: Require a contract-bound owner marker, safe root, process-wide lock, shutdown hook and post-delete verification.
issues.authorizationRequired: Required by the contract cleanup and concurrency gates.
issues.resolutionPerformed: Unique external workspaces, owner-only deletion, shutdown cleanup and process locking are implemented.
validationPerformed: Successful, failed and interrupted cleanup tests pass.
Unowned-path, repository-path, symlink and concurrent-run refusal tests pass.
No generated database or cache is tracked by Git.
issues.residualUncertainty: Final full-proof cleanup measurements remain pending.

evidence: An early fast-profile implementation included proof-only engine measurements and risked overstating its assurance scope.
The historical evaluated index profile is spoc,posc,cosp,ospc,psoc; an early implementation used an unproven cspo variant.
issues.rootCause: Benchmark fields and an index spelling were carried into the implementation before final profile-boundary reconciliation.
issues.proposedResolution: Keep fast profile primary-only and non-proving, keep benchmark acceptance identical, and use the evaluated five-index profile.
issues.authorizationRequired: Required by the live profile and resource constraints.
issues.resolutionPerformed: Fast omits Jena/global/incremental/independent proof; measurements are emitted only by benchmark; the evaluated cosp profile is restored.
validationPerformed: Fast-profile boundary tests pass.
A pre-commit fast run completed under the live time, RSS, disk and output bounds.
issues.residualUncertainty: Final proof and benchmark resource measurements remain pending.

evidence: A proof can begin with the expected authority digest and finish after authority changes unless it rechecks the live snapshot.
Tests and generated manifests do not establish semantic truth without admission and proof evaluation.
issues.rootCause: Permanent source and a boundary-stable authority snapshot did not previously exist.
issues.proposedResolution: Read a coordinator-projected digest at both proof boundaries, admit the committed bounded result, evaluate proof, then advance only the authorised realisation.
issues.authorizationRequired: Only the coordinator may publish through the authoritative compiler and mutate Stardog.
issues.resolutionPerformed: Plain-digest and bounded-JSON authority snapshots plus start/end comparison are implemented and tested.
validationPerformed: Snapshot parsing, expected-digest and boundary-change rejection tests pass.
issues.residualUncertainty: Final evidence envelope admission, proof evaluation and realisation-state advancement remain pending.

evidence: v2/usf/SETUP.md and v2/usf/README.md contain older prose about a Java-backed Stardog CLI.
The current chroot bootstrap uses the JavaScript SDK and does not install Java or the Stardog CLI.
issues.rootCause: Graph-repository documentation was not revised when chroot provisioning changed.
issues.proposedResolution: Correct the owning graph-repository documentation in a separately authorised bounded change.
issues.authorizationRequired: Modification of maldous/usf-graph documentation is outside the authorised parent source path for this realisation.
issues.resolutionPerformed: No submodule mutation or gitlink update was made.
validationPerformed: Current bootstrap source and chroot runtime were inspected to distinguish documentation drift from executable behavior.
issues.residualUncertainty: The stale prose remains until separately authorised.
